mapper.select: SELECT f.id AS farm_id, f.name AS name, f.owner_user_id AS owner_user_id, f.main_category_id AS main_category_id, f.scale AS scale, f.contact_name AS contact_name, f.contact_phone AS contact_phone, f.intro AS intro, f.address AS address, f.province AS province, f.city AS city, f.district AS district, f.township AS township, f.adcode AS adcode, f.longitude AS longitude, f.latitude AS latitude, f.audit_status AS audit_status, f.approved_at AS approved_at, f.disabled AS disabled, f.disabled_at AS disabled_at, f.frozen AS frozen, f.frozen_at AS frozen_at, f.version AS version, f.created_at AS created_at, m.id AS member_id, m.user_id AS user_id, m.role AS role, m.join_type AS join_type, m.last_switch_at AS last_switch_at FROM t_farm_member m JOIN t_farm f ON f.id = m.farm_id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.active_flag = 1 AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND f.deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.id
